official_scoring_enabled_note: ENABLED 2026-08-13 (operator go-live, docs/qwen-mtp-go-live-runbook.md). Flipped together with reference_baseline.publication_allowed on the trusted ref qwen36-mtp-track; the merge to main is deferred, so the ranked workflow's TEMPORARY qwen36-mtp-track ref allowlist entry is still load-bearing. Everything this fixture pins was measured on box 3 against the real Qwen 3.6 27B tower with the pinned native MTP head (tip 6a3bee9): the 8-entry timed_prompt_pool below carries per-entry digests and MEASURED no-op references, and token_fidelity_gate_status is implemented. The precondition that previously held this false -- the pool objects and the hidden MTP correctness golden existing only on box 3 -- is SATISFIED: all 8 pool objects, the hidden MTP correctness golden and the reused serial correctness/GPQA goldens are uploaded to R2 and were re-verified by digest on download in the gates-only dispatch at tip 7b68828.
timed_prompt_pool_note: Contract layer L6 (anti-lottery). Each entry IS a timed MTP reference-rows golden (the object the ranked job downloads and passes to mtp-timed --golden), NOT the prose prompt it was seeded from. Each was generated on box 3 with `mtp-verify --emitted <plan> --generate 513` over the transformed weights tree plus the pinned MTP head, from a DIFFERENT 512-token prose seed (8 distinct domains), and each returned reference_self_consistent=true with 513 rows.
noop_decode_speedup_note: MEASURED on box 3 at tip 6a3bee9, one paired run per entry: raw_ratio = (depth-0 parent_measured_seconds_per_token) / (depth-2 parent_measured_seconds_per_token) over the same 512-token window and the same rows golden. Depth 0 is the TRUE serial control (MTP off, head resident but never consulted, 512 rounds, accepted=rejected=0). The spread across the pool is LARGE -- 0.756 to 1.0915, a 1.44x span -- because acceptance is prompt-dependent (0.344 to 0.585 measured). That spread is exactly what the normalised score exists to remove: an unnormalised raw ratio would hand a candidate drawn on `medicine` a 1.44x advantage over one drawn on `drama` for identical code. Every entry normalises to 1.0 by construction.

target.manifest_sha256_note: SHA-256 of the checked-in manifest file itself, so a tampered manifest is caught before any weight byte is read.
target.expected_source_bytes_note: Sum of the 16 pinned entries in fixtures/reference_qwen3_6_27b_4bit.sha256, which pins every file of the upstream revision including .gitattributes.
target.model_type_note: The TRANSFORMED runtime tree declares qwen3_5_text and loads as Qwen35TextModel with the `language_model.` text-tower prefix stripped; the raw pinned reference declares qwen3_5 and loads as the Qwen35Model wrapper. Both are MTP-capable and both are accepted by the worker (verified on box 3 at this tip: layout=textModel and layout=wrappedTextModel both reach the protocol hello).

mtp_head.tensor_count_note: Pinned in MLXFastConstants.qwenMTPHeadTensorCount and asserted at load: a head tree that lost or gained a tensor fails the load instead of drafting from a partly-uninitialised head.
mtp_head.merge_note: The head is a SEPARATELY PINNED tree, merged at load under the `mtp.` key prefix before sanitize and before the quantization walk. It is resident on BOTH sides of the pair, so its residency cost is charged to the serial denominator too; only the drafting differs.
mtp_head.residency_verified: Byte-verified on box 3 against fixtures/qwen3_6_27b_mtp_head.sha256: 8/8 files match sha256 and byte count, and the staging directory contains exactly those 8 files. The 8th is .gitattributes (34448b82c17d60fec9b65b1f093c115ddbaadc04beb1b0140b6bfed2e012a930, 1570 B), a genuine file of the pinned upstream revision that the original 7-record manifest omitted; it is now pinned rather than deleted from the cache.

protocol.name: trusted_qwen_mtp_block_v1
protocol.serial_control_depth_note: 0 means MTP OFF: one token per target forward, no draft, no head cache, no head forward, no verify window, no rollback. It is NOT 1. Depth 1 still drafts one token and accepts ~70% of those drafts (measured 0.699 on box 3), so dividing by depth 1 measures depth 2 against one-deep speculation rather than against serial decode, and understates the gain. The depth-0 leg is asserted structurally, not assumed: round_count == decode tokens, accepted == rejected == 0, declared == target_tail == decode tokens, is_serial_control true, uses_native_mtp_head false.

reference_baseline._note: The paired depth-0 serial control, the per-prompt no-op references and the thermal/telemetry envelope were all measured on box 3 at tip 6a3bee9. publication_allowed was flipped to true on 2026-08-13 by the operator's go-live runbook (docs/qwen-mtp-go-live-runbook.md step D); it gates ranked scoring together with official_scoring_enabled, and both are now true. The installed and calibrated on-box baseline tree is e86655528c2abe534aa2e61a454565237801aa2d, pinned by path (/opt/bench-runner/baseline/qwen3.6-27b-mtp-v1/current) and by the signed section-9d manifest rather than by any workflow commit variable.

proposed_scoring.score: qwen_mtp_decode_speedup = (paired_serial_decode_sec_per_token at --mtp-depth 0) / (candidate decode_sec_per_token at --mtp-depth 2), over the same rows golden and the same parent-counted 512-token window
proposed_scoring.aggregation: ratio_of_means: mean(serial seconds/token across accepted pairs) / mean(candidate seconds/token across accepted pairs)
proposed_scoring.denominator_authority: trusted parent wall time divided by the parent-configured decode token count; worker-reported timing is never scored

normalized_scoring.rationale: The anti-lottery sampler draws one pool prompt uniformly at random per run, and the measured no-op reference spans 0.756 to 1.0915 across the pool. Without normalisation the draw would dominate the score.
normalized_scoring.reference_source: timed_prompt_pool[].noop_decode_speedup, keyed by sha256. Each entry's own measured no-op normalises to 1.0.
normalized_scoring.published_score: score = normalised ratio-of-means; metrics carry BOTH the raw ratio and the normalised value

proposed_scoring.token_fidelity_gate: Every emitted token must equal the serial trajectory: mtp-verify at the candidate depth must return all_tokens_matched=true AND parity_all_ok=true, with the row ledger CLOSED (reference_checked_row_total == declared_rows_total, and accepted + rejected + target_tail == declared_rows_total). Verified on box 3 across all 8 pool prompts and the hidden correctness golden.
proposed_scoring.stall_guardrail: a run whose max block latency exceeds 4x its p50 block latency is rejected. CALIBRATION NOTE: as measured, max_block_request_seconds is the FIRST block after the seed prefill and is a one-time warmup, not a stall -- it is flat to within 1% across 8/32/128/512-round windows (serial ~0.19s, depth-2 ~0.267s). At the 512 window the serial leg therefore trips 4x (measured 5.72-5.90x) while the depth-2 leg does not (3.30-3.36x). The guardrail should exclude the first block before this track is enabled.
proposed_scoring.prefill_component: none; seed prefill is charged inside the decode measurement, identically on both legs
proposed_scoring.leaderboard: separate qwen3.6-27b-mtp-v1 namespace, never mixed with the serial or DFlash tracks
proposed_scoring.measurement_protocol: minimum three accepted thermal-gated pairs per session (target four), alternating order
